sheets.prompt: Character design sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the headwear of a sun-bleached harbour town of salt pans and sailcloth, terracotta and white, and the dock-workers under its piers. Three pieces, each worn by a head-and-shoulders figure, front and three-quarter view: a sailcloth head-wrap against the glare, one end tucked; a fisher's sou'wester of waxed cloth with a long back brim; a sun-bleached hood with a salt-stiff edge. Every piece sits close on the head, one clear silhouette each, readable from far away. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, terracotta, sailcloth cream and sea blue, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, costume party.
